title: Senior Product Owner - Internal Operating System & AI (f/m/d)
description:
Tangany, based in Munich, is a highly innovative technology company with a market-leading B2B solution for the custody of digital assets on the blockchain (e.g. cryptocurrencies & tokenized assets). Our solution is already used by more than 40 institutional customers. Tangany is regulated by the German federal financial supervisory authority, BaFin.
Using our modern API, we enable our customers to easily and securely integrate blockchain functionalities into their systems. This white-label solution reduces development costs and time, enabling fast market access and ease of use for end users. Regulatory requirements can be covered for appropriate assets via Tangany's crypto custody license if required. For our continued growth, we are looking for a Senior Product Owner - Internal Operating System & AI (f/m/d) to join our team.
Your role
Our engineering works in three product teams. Two of them build for our partners: one the portals, the other the API and our custody core. The third works inward, and you will own its product. Its mandate is to run Tangany's operations as efficiently as possible. Business and product operations processes such as transaction operations, billing, forecasting and KPI reporting get digitised, automated, or handed to AI agents where that is the better solution. Much of this runs today on a self-hosted Retool platform. Whether we keep extending it or replace it with an AI-native solution on top of the APIs our other teams provide is one of the first calls you will shape.
The team works process-first. You map each process end-to-end with the people who run it, redesign it, and only then decide how it gets automated. The team's tech lead owns the engineering, and you own what gets built, in which order and why. Beyond your team, you are responsible for AI at Tangany: governance, enablement and tooling for the whole company.

title: Manufacturing Quality Engineer
description:
Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots.
Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment.
Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry.
The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously. Increasingly, we also build custom hardware to adapt our machines for highly specialized, robust applications beyond traditional excavation.
About the role
We are looking for a manufacturing quality engineer to own the quality and reliability of the Gravis hardware package that turns regular excavators into awesome, autonomous machines. You will work with our engineering and production team in Zurich defining and implementing quality measures like incoming inspections, supply chain validations, failure analysis and product return teardowns to enable our custom AI hardware a safe and reliable operation of heavy machines. You are capable of working both independently and with others, and are intrinsically driven to solve challenging applied problems with a rigorous attention to detail and an exploratory imagination.
You are our first quality hire. There is no dedicated quality team, no lab, and no play

title: Medical Coder (Outpatient)
description:
Job Summary
Job Summary:
Location: 100% remote (US only), supporting VA medical centers in VISN 7 Term: 12-month base period plus four 12-month option periods. Pay: 25.00/hr-30.00/hr
About the role
Aptive Resources is hiring remote outpatient coders to support Veterans Affairs medical centers in Georgia, Alabama, and South Carolina. You'll code clinic visits, ancillary services, and outpatient surgery for Veterans, using the VA's electronic health record. This is the largest part of the contract, with about 240,000 outpatient encounters a year across the Atlanta, Columbia, Birmingham, Augusta, and Central Alabama facilities.
Primary Responsibilities
What you'll do

• Code outpatient encounters, including clinic visits, urgent care, radiology, lab, other ancillary services, and outpatient surgery, using ICD-10-CM, CPT-4, and HCPCS Level II.

• Assign E/M levels according to current E/M guidelines, CPT Assistant, and Coding Clinic.

• Apply NCCI bundling edits, and add modifiers when appropriate to override them (for example 25, 59, and 91).

• Check that multiple CPT codes aren't parts of a larger procedure that one code describes.

• Assign an ICD-10 diagnosis to each ancillary or diagnostic test, based on why it was ordered.

• Review documentation in CPRS and enter codes and data in the VistA Patient Care Encounter (PCE) package through the VA-approved encoder.

• Decide whether an encounter is billable, and flag duplicate encounters, encounters created in error, and records that don't support the codes.

• Re-review your coded records when the VA questions them before billing or after a claim is denied.

• Maintain at least 95% accuracy and meet each facility's turnaround times.

Minimum Qualifications
Required qualifications

• An active CPC, CCS, CCS-P, RHIT, RHIA, or CPC-H credential.

• At least 2 years of recent outpatient coding experience, including E/M, ancillary services, and outpatient procedures.

• Completion of an accredited coding, HIM, or health information technician program.

• Formal training in anatomy and physiology, medical terminology, pathophysiology, pharmacology, and reimbursement methods.

• Strong knowledge of CPT, HCPCS, NCCI edits, and modifiers.

• Proficiency with an industry-standard encoder.

• US citizenship, and the ability to pass a federal background investigation (NACI) and fingerprinting.

• A private, secure home workspace with reliable high-speed internet.

Preferred qualifications

• Experience with VA systems, including VistA, CPRS, PCE, and Integrated Billing.

• Experience coding outpatient surgery or ambulatory surgery.

• Experience coding radiology or lab for a hospital.

Additional requirements

• Complete the VA's annual Privacy and Information Security Awareness and HIPAA training (TMS 10176 and 10203) before starting, and once a year after that.

• Follow AHIMA's Standards of Ethical Coding and VA confidentiality rules. Don't use "incident to" billing rules.

•
Aptive provides the laptop, encoder, and reference materials.

About Aptive

Arrow ARC supports Veterans Health Administration facilities and offices across the U.S. with health care staffing and program support via the 10-year Integrated Critical Staffing Program (ICSP). We provide staffing solutions to address critical shortages in VHA medical facilities caused by turnover, recruitment issues, seasonal needs, surges or emergencies.
Arrow is a certified Service-Disabled, Veteran-Owned Small Business joint venture between Artemis ARC and Aptive Resources, two award-winning companies that share an agile, mission-focused, results driven approach in the federal sector.​ Arrow provides management consulting services and specializes in working with federal government agencies like the Department of Veterans Affairs and Office of Personnel Management.​

title: Senior Software Engineer, Native Mobile
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

Guest & Host Technology builds the end-to-end experience that connects people around the world: from the first search to the moment a trip becomes a memory. Because that experience lives natively on iOS and Android, with no cross-platform framework in between, we're looking for engineers who move fluidly across both platforms to keep architecture, performance, and product quality coherent everywhere our guests and hosts show up.

 

The Difference You Will Make:

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer who can operate as a true dual-platform native engineer - someone with solid, current fluency in both iOS and Android. You'll own features end-to-end across both apps, and you'll be one of the people trusted to make architectural calls that need to hold up identically on Swift and Kotlin.

You'll write production code on both platforms, and you'll also be expected to think beyond any single feature: flagging where our two native codebases are drifting apart, where a shared contract (like our GraphQL client layer) needs to evolve, and helping less experienced engineers ramp into dual-platform work.

 

A Typical Day: 

• Design and ship features across our iOS (Swift) and Android (Kotlin) native codebases, often the same initiative, shipped in parallel on both platforms

• Partner with design and product to translate one product spec into two platform-idiomatic implementations, rather than porting one platform's UI onto the other

• Uphold architecture, performance, and app-size standards that apply equally to both platforms

• Weigh in on shared client contracts (schema, logging, testing frameworks) consumed by both apps, and flag when a change would let the platforms drift apart

• Help other engineers ramp into dual-platform work through pairing and code review

• Participate in technical reviews and architecture discussions where your judgment is expected to span both platforms, not just one

Your Expertise:

• 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, with deep, current, hands-on expertise in both native iOS (Swift, UIKit/SwiftUI) and native Android (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose), not legacy exposure to one platform and active work on the other

• A track record of independently shipping medium-to-large complexity features on either platform without ramp-up, and the ability to read, debug, and reason about the other platform's code even where you're less deep

• Solid opinions on mobile architecture, backed by experience keeping two independent native codebases coherent at scale

• Comfort owning a feature end-to-end with real ambiguity, and identifying when a decision needs to be escalated versus made independently

• Experience partnering closely with design and product to translate ambiguous requirements into concrete, platform-appropriate implementations

• A pragmatic view on cross-platform tooling - you understand why fully native matters here, and you're not looking for a role where you can lean on React Native or Flutter instead of doing the harder, more durable work

 

Your Location:

This position is US - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. title: Post-Training Applied Researcher
description:
ABOUT BASETEN

Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-our-series-f/, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products.

THE ROLE

This role sits at the applied end of our post-training research efforts. You will work directly with stakeholders from the world’s fastest-growing AI companies to post-train open-source models that outperform frontier closed models on their specialised tasks. Your day-to-day is finding creative ways to extract signal from complex, domain-specific datasets and building the reward functions, environments, eval harnesses, and training pipelines that turn that signal into better models. The models you train ship to production and reach millions of users.

We are looking for people with hands-on LLM fine-tuning and RL experience. Researchers who are excited by the prospect of shipping models into production, who can translate a customer's domain-specific requirements into an effective training curriculum, and who know when to be rigorous and when to iterate fast.

RECENT RESEARCH

- Dense, on-policy or both? https://www.baseten.co/research/dense-on-policy-or-both/

- Repeated kv cache for long-running agents https://www.baseten.co/research/repeated-kv-cache-for-long-running-agents/

- Distillation without the dark - replicating black-box on-policy distillation on Baseten https://www.baseten.co/research/distillation-without-the-dark/

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Design and run post-training pipelines: SFT, GRPO, DPO, RLVR, reward function engineering, and synthetic data generation.

- Build task-specific training environments and evals tailored to customer domains like healthcare, code generation, and legal, spanning multi-turn tool use, sandboxed execution, and agentic workflows.

- Work directly with customers to translate production data into training signal, designing reward loops from real usage patterns and handling distribution shift.

- Run and analyze training experiments end-to-end: diagnose reward hacking, importance sampling drift, and advantage estimation instabilities.

- Publish findings at top venues and contribute to Baseten's open-source training libraries.

QUALIFICATIONS

- Hands-on experience training LLMs with reinforcement learning - demonstrated understanding of GRPO or PPO beyond recipe-level reproduction, including group advantage computation, clipped objectives, and KL penalty design

- Strong intuition for reward engineering: the ability to distinguish between a reward that trains effectively and one that will exploit at scale

- Experience building multi-turn agent environments with tool use, not limited to single-turn question-answering setups

- Comfort working across the full pipeline from dataset construction through training, evaluation, and deployment

- Experience with production ML systems. Preference for candidates who have closed a training-inference loop where production data feeds back into model improvement

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience with RL training frameworks

- Publications at NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, focused on RL for LLMs, reward modeling, or alignment

BENEFITS

- Competitive compensation, including meaningful equity

- (U.S. only) 100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance for employee and dependents

- Flexible PTO policy including company wide Winter Break (our offices are closed from Christmas Eve to New Year's Day!)

- Paid parental leave

- Fertility and family-building stipend through Carrot

- (U.S. only) Company-facilitated 401(k)

title: Account Manager
description:
Position Overview
The Account Manager is a quota-carrying sales role focused exclusively on generating incremental annual recurring revenue (ARR) through cross-sell and upsell within STACK’s existing customer base. This person proactively hunts for expansion opportunities, builds their own pipeline, and owns the expansion sales process from prospecting through close.
The Account Manager works in concert with the Customer Success (CS) team to understand customer goals, product usage, and business needs, then translates those insights into qualified expansion opportunities. CS provides customer context and coordinates ongoing success activities; the Account Manager owns proactive expansion outreach, commercial discovery, proposals, negotiation, and closing.
This role does not own renewals, customer support, or retention management. Success is measured primarily by self-generated expansion ARR that the Account Manager proactively sources and closes within the customer base.
What You'll Do:

• Consistently meet or exceed quota for self-generated expansion ARR through cross-sell and upsell to existing customers.

• Proactively prospect within assigned accounts through targeted calls, email, and other appropriate channels to uncover unmet needs and expansion opportunities.

• Identify opportunities for additional licenses, higher-tier packages, complementary products, and recurring add-ons that align with customer needs.

• Build and maintain a qualified expansion pipeline through account research, outbound outreach, stakeholder development, and disciplined follow-up.

• Own the end-to-end expansion sales process, including discovery, qualification, value demonstration, business case development, proposals, negotiation, and close.

• Develop account plans for priority customers that identify expansion potential, relevant workflows, stakeholder coverage, buying processes, and next actions.

• Monitor and respond promptly to signals that identify high-value expansion targets within the existing customer base, including product usage patterns, interest in additional capabilities, license needs, and customer growth. Prioritize these accounts for proactive sales engagement, validate the opportunity through discovery, and convert relevant signals into qualified cross-sell and upsell pipeline.

• Work in concert with CS on account priorities, customer context, outreach timing, and stakeholder introductions to deliver coordinated customer engagement.

• Build relationships beyond existing contacts to reach decision-makers, economic buyers, additional teams, and business units with expansion potential.

• Partner with Solutions Consultants and other internal resources to demonstrate solutions and validate expansion use cases.

• Coordinate the handoff of closed expansion business to CS and relevant delivery teams so purchased products and licenses can be adopted successfully.

• Route renewal questions, support requests, and account health concerns to the responsible teams while keeping expansion activity coordinated with CS.

• Maintain accurate Salesforce records, including opportunity source, qualification, expansion ARR, stakeholders, next steps, close dates, and forecast categories.

• Forecast expansion opportunities with discipline and communicate pipeline gaps, deal risks, and actions needed to achieve quota.

• Stay current on construction workflows, STACK capabilities, and competitive alternatives to position expansion solutions effectively.

Success Metrics
The primary measure of success is self-generated expansion ARR closed against quota. Self-generated ARR means incremental recurring revenue from cross-sell or upsell opportunities that the Account Manager proactively identifies, initiates, and advances to close. Renewed baseline ARR, automatic price increases, and one-time services revenue are not included in this measure.
CS collaboration informs and supports the sales motion; opportunity sourcing must be documented accurately

description:
General skills: There are four (4) distinct delivery phases in which user experience designers (task based I&IT consultants) produce deliverables following Ontario Digital Service Design playbook, which outlines the standard process for user experience design.
Delivery Phase 1) Discovery :
Before building a solution, a project team needs to find out whether users need it and whether other solutions exist. The UX Designers responsibilities during this phase are to build an understanding of the problem space/statement, the long and short-term business goals, and the user and business needs.
Deliverables :

• Facilitate the Kick-off meeting with the project team to produce such outputs as:

• Business Model Canvas

• 5 Whys

• User Personas

• Stakeholder Mapping

• Strategy Map

• Short- and Long-Term Goals

• Fears and Challenges

• Problem Statement

• Facilitate user research activities to produce such outputs as:

• User interview topic Maps, a summary of interrelated topics for the user interview

• User Interview Scripts to plan and guide user discussion

• User Interview Synthesis (collection, aggregation and analysis) of written observations recorded during each interview

• User research findings report

• Inception (Science Fair Day):

• Showcases the work and key findings from this stage to stakeholders outside of the core project team

• Aligns entire team (business, technical) on what the next steps will be

• Planning activities for next phase (Alpha)

• Other deliverables typically delivered in this phase include:

title: Quality Assurance Analyst FTC
description:
Flexigrant is one of the specialist software businesses within a portfolio of Fluent Software Group, which is an operating group under Valsoft Corporation , an acquirer of specialist vertical-market software businesses with a long-term, buy-and-hold approach.
Being part of the wider group provides additional stability, expertise and opportunities to collaborate with other specialist software businesses, while allowing Flexigrant to retain its own culture and market focus/ specialist market position.
You will be joining a focused business with its own identity, goals and ambitions, while benefiting from the long-term backing, shared expertise and international network of Fluent Software Group and Valsoft.
Flexigrant is cloud-based grant management software built for organisations that award funding, from community foundations to central government. It replaces spreadsheets and email with a single system covering applications, eligibility, assessment, awards, monitoring, and reporting, with a full audit trail throughout.
The platform replaces disconnected spreadsheets, emails and paper-based processes with one secure, configurable system, giving grant managers a complete and up-to-date view of every programme, application and award. Flexigrant also creates a clear audit trail of actions and decisions, helping organisations maintain transparency and meet their governance and reporting responsibilities.
Trusted by more than 100 organisations worldwide, the platform supports grant programmes of varying sizes and complexity. In the last 12 months alone, more than £6.4 billion in new grant funding was awarded through Flexigrant, demonstrating the important role its technology plays in helping funding reach research, communities and worthwhile causes efficiently.
The Role
As QA Analyst, you will own the quality of what we ship. You will plan and run testing across Flexigrant, from exploratory, functional and regression testing through to building automated tests, working closely with our developers and Product Manager to catch issues early.
This is a hands-on role for a fast learner who enjoys getting to know a complex product in depth. Much of that product knowledge is built on the job, alongside the development team, so a real appetite to learn is essential.
It is also an AI-native role. You will use AI tools such as Claude or GitHub Copilot every day to plan, create and maintain tests, grow our automation and help build quality in as Flexigrant modernises. AI fluency will be explored at interview, so be ready to show how you work.
We are remote-first: you will work with colleagues across locations and are trusted to work wherever you are based.
Key Responsibilities

• You will plan, design and run manual testing across Flexigrant, including exploratory, functional, regression and edge-case testing.

• You will build and maintain automated tests and help grow our automated test coverage.

• You will work with developers and the Product Manager to refine requirements and turn them into clear, testable acceptance criteria.

• You will reproduce and document issues clearly, giving developers concise, actionable feedback so they can resolve them quickly.

• You will carry out API testing and use SQL to validate data and investigate issues.

• You will support releases each sprint, balancing planned testing with reactive support, and take part in refinement, sprint planning, stand-ups and retrospectives.

• You will use AI tooling as a core part of your daily workflow to improve testing processes and speed up delivery.

• You will share product knowledge across the team and help improve our QA processes and practices.

Key Skills, Knowledge and Abilities

• 4+ years in a software QA or testing role, ideally within an Agile team.

• Strong manual testing skills (exploratory, functional, regression and edge-case), including web applications across devices and browsers.

• Experience with automated testing tools such as Selenium or Cypress.

title: Inventory Control Technician
description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

HOW WE OPERATE

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

ROLE SCOPE

- Execute the daily cycle count reconciliation for five data center sites and warehouses from the WMS count export, following the documented method step for step: dedupe the scans, net shortages against recorded transactions, and publish each site's variance tracker before the morning deadline, seven days a week on a rotation.

- Post the WMS corrections each variance calls for (quantity adjustments with reason codes, location transfers, part alias fixes) within the authority limits set by the Program Manager, Inventory Control, and log the site lead's root cause and resolution on every row until it closes.

- Request same-day recounts and bin checks through the established site contacts, confirm the results land in the system, and verify on the next count that the correction held.

- Triage every below-minimum and zero-on-hand alert the day it fires against the alert decision tree, enter and maintain min/max values and exception fixes as directed, and escalate anything the rules do not cover to the Program Manager the same day.

- Prepare the system-pulled, cross-checked inputs for the daily customer count report and the weekly accuracy review, and work the record-integrity backlog (17,000+ serialized assets without a location, duplicate bin records, 3PL discrepancy lists) against the plan and dates the Program Manager sets.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- You've done cycle counts and variance reconciliation as a daily job in a WMS, and you can show a tracker or log you kept current for months.

- You work a documented procedure the same way every day, and when a step does not fit the situation you flag it and take action.

- You find the wrong row with lookups, pivots, dedupe and formula checks, and you've caught your own errors before anyone else saw them.

- You've posted adjustments and transfers in an inventory system with reason codes, and you know which ones you're allowed to post yourself and which ones need a sign-off.

- You've asked a warehouse team you don't work beside to recount a bin the same day, and you closed the loop when the result came back.

- You've kept a seven-day cadence on a rotation, working remotely from the operation

We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!

Your opportunity
New Relic is seeking a hands-on  Senior Manger, Partner Sales to lead the AMER business. This is not a "management-from-afar" role. We need a hands-on, battle-tested leader who will be in the trenches with their team and our Account Executives (AEs) - coaching them on how to nurture, mature, and close new business through the power of the channel. You will lead the charge in a maturing environment, turning ambiguity into execution and evidencing progress over perfection.

What you'll do

Your mission is to accelerate New Relic’s partner sales business with channel partners including VAR, GSI and regional specialists. You will build a team of hunters to overlay the AMER sales team to drive Partner Sourced ACR and launch revitalized sales motions such as MSP and leverage regional services partners to ramp consumption.
Key Responsibilities

• The ACR Engine: Primary accountability for driving Partner Sourced ACR across North America and LATAM. You will ensure the channel is a consistent and predictable contributor to AMER’s growth.

• Deal Orchestration: Act as the "Deal Maker." You will personally support your team and the direct sales organization to mature partner-led opportunities from discovery to close.

• In-the-Trenches Mentorship: We don't want a reporter; we want a coach. You will spend your time upskilling your team on deal mechanics, partner positioning, and cross-functional alignment.

• Sales Alignment: Build a "one-team" culture between the Channel organization and the Direct Sales AEs, ensuring that partner engagement is viewed as a competitive advantage, not a hurdle or cost center.

• Ecosystem Mastery: Leverage your existing network in the Observability to elevate partner relationships and drive executive commitment.

• Operational Resilience: You will operate in an environment that is still evolving. You must be comfortable building the car whilst driving it at the same time

Measures of Success (KPIs)

• Partner Sourced ACR: Achievement of regional gross ACR targets sourced directly by partners

• Pipeline Quality: Measurable improvement in the "Stage 2 to Closed-Won" conversion rate for partner-led deals

• Team Quota Attainment: The percentage of your direct reports hitting or exceeding their sourced-revenue targets

• Direct Sales Alignment: Increasing the "Partner Attachment Rate" across all AMER sales territories

 
This role requires  

• AMER Network: You bring a wealth of executive relationships across the top North American and LATAM VARs, SIs, and regional partners

• The "Deal Maker" DNA: Proven track record of personally helping sales teams close deals through the channel.

• Resilience & Agility: You thrive in environments that are "under construction." You are a builder who can navigate internal ambiguity to deliver external results.

Nice to Have

• Bilingual Advantage:  Proficiency in Spanish or Portuguese is a significant plus for the LATAM component of the role.

• Observability Veteran: Mandatory. You have deep experience in the Observability, APM, or Log Management space. You understand the technical and business value drivers in this specific market.

Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

title: Account Solutions Architect - Greenfield - France
description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at  www.coreweave.com .

 

We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.

 

What You’ll Do:

The infrastructure powering the AI era doesn’t sell itself, and the customers building on it don’t want to be sold to. They want a peer. You’ll work as part of a focused three-person team alongside one Account Executive and one Account Manager, together responsible for landing new accounts and expanding within them across the region. The customers you’ll work with are AI labs, research institutions, and enterprises running some of the most demanding GPU workloads in the world. This is a role for someone who shows up with substance, who can hold a real conversation about model training and MLOps tooling in the morning and cluster networking in the afternoon, and who finds the space between infrastructure and application more interesting than either on its own.

About the Role:

As an Account Solution Architect covering Northern EMEA, you’ll move across the full stack depending on what the customer needs, from ML training workflows and MLOps platforms like Weights & Biases to bare metal GPU infrastructure and physical AI deployments. This isn’t a role built around a single layer of the stack, but the majority of your conversations will live in the ML layer. You’ll be expected to go deeper than most when the infrastructure conversation demands it, while staying commercially aware enough to support both new logo pursuits and in-flight account expansion. This role requires up to 40% travel.

In this role, you will:

• Cover Northern EMEA, with a focus on the Nordics and Benelux regions (Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Finland, Netherlands, Belgium, and Luxembourg).

• Work closely with one Account Executive and one Account Manager as a dedicated three-person unit, supporting the full land and expand motion across the region.

• Lead technical discovery with prospects and existing customers to understand model training requirements, MLOps workflows, and infrastructure constraints.

• Design and present solutions spanning ML infrastructure, GPU compute, storage, networking, Kubernetes-based orchestration, and MLOps tooling.

• Run proof-of-concept engagements and architecture reviews, and see them through to a decision.

• Act as the internal voice of the customer, feeding technical requirements and product gaps back to Engineering and Product.

• Maintain clear documentation of customer architectures, solution designs, and outstanding technical questions.

Who You Are:

• 3+ years in a pre-sales, solutions engineering, or solutions architecture role, ideally with a focus on AI/ML platforms, cloud infrastructure, or HPC.

• Strong working knowledge of ML training and inference workflows - you understand how models are built, optimized, and deployed, not just where they run.

• Hands-on familiarity with MLOps platforms and the tooling AI teams use day-to-day, including experiment tracking, pipeline orchestration, and model serving.

• Experience with AI frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX.

• Comfortable going below the SaaS layer when the conversation demands it - GPU topology, network fabric, and cluster architecture shouldn’t be unfamiliar territory.

• Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and containerized workloads at scale.

• Strong communication skills - you can adjust your register from a research engineer to a VP of Infrastructure without losing credibility at either end.

• Experience managing multiple

title: Social Media Marketing Assistant
description:
About HighKey

HighKey Agency is a digital PR and social media powerhouse specializing in building elite personal and brand presences in the aesthetic industry-from top-tier plastic surgeons to high-growth med spas.

We engineer content systems that drive visibility, leads, and long-term brand equity-at scale.

Our team moves fast, executes ruthlessly, and obsesses over results. If you’re looking to break into a high-performance agency, this is your entry point-but only if you’re ready to deliver more than what’s expected .

Role Overview

As a Social Media Marketing Assistant , you’ll work directly with our Social Media Managers to help execute world-class content, support account management, and contribute to client-facing success.

This is not a basic scheduling role . You’ll contribute ideas, organize deliverables, coordinate content, and help manage performance for high-profile aesthetic brands. You’ll be expected to take ownership over your tasks, solve problems, and level up fast.

If you’re hungry to build your career in digital marketing-and you thrive in high-speed environments-this is your launchpad.

What You’ll Do

1. Content Coordination + Prep

• Help build and organize viral content scripts for Instagram, TikTok, Reels, and YouTube Shorts.

• Assist with content prep for client filming sessions (scripts, hooks, trends, shot lists).

• Work alongside video editors and graphic designers to move content through the pipeline.

2. Platform Management + Engagement

• Monitor and respond to comments, DMs, and tags across platforms.

• Track trends and help brainstorm fast-moving ideas for reactive content.

• Assist in managing community tone, voice, and consistency for each client brand.

3. Performance Support + Reporting

• Pull analytics and track KPIs weekly: reach, retention, engagement rate, virality.

• Assist with preparing client-facing performance reports and insights.

• Identify what’s working and flag what’s not-so we can pivot fast.

4. Administrative Execution

• Keep things clean and moving inside Notion, Basecamp, and Hootsuite.

• Help maintain organized content libraries, file systems, and calendars.

• Communicate across internal teams (design, editing, accounts) to keep projects on track.

You’re a Fit If…

• You have 1-2 years of real-world experience in content marketing, social media, or digital strategy (agency or in-house).

• You’ve managed posts, calendars, or performance for real brands-this isn’t your first exposure to client work.

• You know your way around Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and Meta tools .

• You’re extremely organized , detail-obsessed, and good at tracking moving parts.

• You’re not afraid to ask questions, take initiative, and move fast.

• You have experience using tools like Notion, Hootsuite, Canva, Google Docs, Basecamp , etc.

• You’re passionate about branding, storytelling, and content that performs.

Bonus If You Have:

• Experience working with aesthetics, med spa, cosmetic, or personal branding clients.

• Video editing or videography background (CapCut, Canva, Adobe).

• Insight into how to make content go viral .

Growth Path

This is not just a task-based role-it’s a pipeline into Social Media Manager positions at HighKey. As you prove you can think strategically, communicate clearly, and execute fast, you’ll get more ownership, more client-facing exposure, and eventually full account leadership.

Culture + Commitment

•
Full-time, hourly role starting at $15-$20/hr , depending on experience.

• Remote position with flexible hours (but responsiveness matters).

• Promotion potential into salaried client management roles.

• We value speed, clarity, extreme ownership, and team accountability.

How to Apply

Submit your resume + Portfolio

📩 Extra credit : Share a recent TikTok or Reel trend and how you’d adapt it for a plastic surgeon or med spa.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems - robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

WHY THIS MATTERS

Runway is building AI to simulate the world. We think world models, not language models alone, are the path to general-purpose simulation: systems that experience the world, learn from their mistakes, and change how stories get told, how science gets done, and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Applied AI is where that research meets a customer with a deadline. Every one of the world's largest studios, brands, and platforms hits a moment where Runway stops being a demo and becomes the way they actually make things. Our team exists for that moment, and we organize around one question: what's blocking this customer from production, and how do we remove it?

ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a role for people who want to own a problem, not an account. You'll sit with the biggest studios, brands, and Fortune 100 companies in the world, figure out what's actually standing between them and production, and build whatever removes it. Some weeks that's a workflow. Some weeks it's a plugin or an integration nobody has written yet. Some weeks it's getting a room of executives to make a decision they've been putting off.

Your work will be on screen: Emmy-winning shows, Oscar-winning films, Super Bowl commercials, the stuff people actually watch. And the things you build for one customer tend to become product for all of them. Our team's first Shopify plugin started as a customer blocker and was in engineering's hands within a few weeks. We treat this team as R&D for that reason, not as a cost center.

We have offices in NYC, San Francisco, Seattle, and London.

NO TWO WEEKS ARE THE SAME, BUT YOU CAN EXPECT TO:

- Find the real problem: sit with the creative, technical, and executive teams at a customer, map how they actually work, and locate the blocker between them and production. Usually it's one of three things: a missing integration, an unproven pipeline, or a stakeholder who isn't convinced yet.

- Build the first of its kind: the demo that shows a studio head or a Fortune 100 CMO something nobody has shown them before. Working proofs of concept on the customer's own brand, footage, or catalog, often built in a day or two before the meeting, and the best of them become product for everyone.

- Make it reusable: turn the one-off that unblocked one customer into the workflow, plugin, or integration the next ten customers start from.

- Run the evaluation: own evaluation plans end to end, guide managed trials, build tailored demos on the customer's own footage and brand, and carry the technical side of deal cycles with AEs.

- Scope deployments that land: 4-12 week engagements with customer-defined success criteria, a hands-on builder and an executive sponsor on their side from day one, and enough discipline to keep them on scope when the asks start piling up.

- Get customers to production fast: take new technical and non-technical customers from signed contract to first production call in days rather than quarters, grow API-only accounts into Platform

• Collaborate directly with customer networking, cloud, and platform teams

• Conduct technical workshops, trainings, and whiteboard sessions for customers and partners

Minimum Requirements

• Strong cloud and networking fundamentals

title: Sr. Solution Architect
description:
About Wherobots

Wherobots is the AI Context Engine for the Physical World: the missing infrastructure layer for AI that needs to reason about our physical reality. Existing AI context infrastructure was built for text, code, documents, databases, and the internet. The most consequential enterprise decisions also depend on the physical world: supply chains, climate exposure, geopolitics, infrastructure, and more.

Our two products let teams use familiar SQL and Python to analyze physical-world data and give AI agents persistent context about their organization’s assets and operations:

•
Wherobots DB is a fully distributed spatial analytics engine with a Rust-native execution layer. It processes vector and raster data in the same engine at scale, enabling precise spatial joins across billions of geometries and analysis that connects imagery with business data.

•
RasterFlow is a fully distributed, serverless engine for raster preparation and computer vision. It processes satellite imagery at planetary scale, runs built-in or custom PyTorch models, and turns imagery into predictions and spatial features that teams can analyze with Wherobots DB.

Wherobots was founded by the original creators of Apache Sedona, the open-source spatial computing platform with more than 80 million downloads. Apache Sedona is used in production by tens of thousands of organizations, including many Fortune 500 companies.

About the role

Wherobots is looking for an experienced Solution Architect to help enterprise customers design and adopt geospatial data solutions. You will partner with sales throughout technical discovery, solution design, demonstrations, and proofs of concept, then help customers move into production and expand their use of Wherobots .

This is a customer-facing role with hands-on technical work . You will help customers connect raster ETL, spatial analytics, and computer vision or machine learning use cases to their business needs. You will also create reusable technical resources and bring customer feedback to product and engineering teams.

Responsibilities

•
Pre-sales: Lead technical discovery. Partner with sales and marketing to understand customer business challenges, data infrastructure, and analytics needs. Translate those requirements into proposed solutions and clear success criteria.

•
Pre-sales: Design solution architectures. Develop architecture diagrams, integration flows, and deployment plans tailored to customer environments, including platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, AWS, and Google Earth Engine.

•
Pre-sales: Deliver demonstrations and proofs of concept. Build customer-specific demonstrations, notebooks, and benchmarks that show how Wherobots supports raster ETL, spatial analytics, and ML workflows. Help customers evaluate technical fit and business value.

•
Post-sales: Lead architectural onboarding. Guide new customers from evaluation into production, working with their engineering and analytics teams to establish implementation plans and operational best practices.

•
Post-sales: Support customer implementations. Help customers design data ingestion and transformation pipelines, spatial analysis workflows, and model inference integrations, including storage, querying, visualization, and governance.

•
Post-sales: Troubleshoot technical issues. Serve as a technical escalation point and work with product and support engineering to resolve issues and improve customer deployments.

•
Create reusable technical resources. Develop reference architectures, implementation guides, Jupyter notebooks, tutorials, and technical blog posts. Share practical examples through workshops, webinars, technical events, and community engagement.

•
Inform product direction. Collect customer requirements and implementation feedback to help prioritize improvements to Wherobots capabilities, APIs, and documentation.

Qualifications

• 5+ years of experience in a customer-facing technical role covering pre-sales and post-sales

title: Facilities Coordinator | AU Property
description:

When a leak is reported in a building, someone has to work out what is actually going on. Which areas are affected. Whether it needs a plumber, a roofer or a waterproofing specialist. Whether one quote is enough or three are needed. And what to tell the owners while it is being sorted out. That is this role.
You will manage the day-to-day maintenance of a portfolio of Australian commercial and strata properties, working fully remote from the Philippines on Australian business hours. Every job is yours from the moment it is reported through investigation, quoting, approval, coordination and completion - plumbing, electrical, roofing, waterproofing, leaks, painting, carpentry, glazing, doors, access systems and general building repairs.
It is a high-volume role across multiple sites, and it suits someone with hands-on technical knowledge who can look at a request and know what it needs - working through the requests themselves, not managing a team who does.
You will be choosing which contractor to engage, comparing their quotes and putting a clear recommendation in front of property and strata managers. It is decision-making work rather than passing messages between contractors and clients, and it builds the kind of Australian property and building knowledge that stays with you.
What you’ll be doing

• Reviewing incoming maintenance requests across a portfolio of properties and deciding the appropriate next step

• Working out when an issue needs further investigation, a specialist opinion or additional quotations

• Choosing the right contractor or trade for the job, and coordinating internal technicians, contractors and consultants

• Obtaining, reviewing and comparing contractor quotations, then presenting your recommendation

• Owning each job through access coordination, scheduling, follow-up and completion - including reviewing photos, reports and contractor documentation before you close it

• Keeping property managers, strata managers, owners, tenants and building managers informed throughout

• Identifying urgent and safety-related issues and making sure they are escalated and actioned

• Supporting planned and preventative maintenance, and keeping accurate records of works, quotes and contractor communication

• A practical understanding of building maintenance and the different trades - you can look at a problem and know roughly who needs to fix it

• Experience managing contractors, quotations and repair works

• Confidence dealing directly with property managers, owners, tenants and contractors

• Strong written and verbal English, and the organisation to keep multiple buildings and contractors moving at once

• Sound judgement when prioritising urgent, safety-related and routine maintenance

• Availability to work Monday to Friday, 6:00 AM - 2:30 PM Philippine time

Nice to have

• Experience assessing defects remotely - from photos, written descriptions and contractor reports rather than site visits

• Experience with Australian strata properties, owners corporations or bodies corporate

• Experience with job management, field service, strata management or property management software

• Involvement in planned or preventative maintenance programmes and compliance servicing

• HMO coverage from Day 1

title: Senior AI Product & Partnerships Counsel
description:
We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems - robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

*Titles posted to our careers page are updated regularly to best advertise the role and expected seniority, but internally we have a flat titling system with two types of titles: one for individual contributors and one for people managers.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Preferable to have someone near one of our offices in NYC or San Francisco, but open to hiring around the US for the right candidate.

Join the frontier of shaping generative AI video and its legal landscape as an early lawyer at Runway wearing multiple hats. As AI Product & Partnerships Counsel, your mission is to enable the company to ship better products faster and accelerate product and data partnerships and other go-to-market deals. You are a self-starter who thrives at getting things done in fast-paced, unstructured environments. You have a passion for building scalable initiatives across our product and commercial legal workstreams.

You will serve as a strategic partner to product, engineering, partnerships, sales, marketing, and the Runway Executive Team. Comfort working within a highly technical, rapidly evolving area of the law is a must.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Become a go-to advisor for product legal matters, from design to launch, by providing pragmatic, product-motivated advice

At HelloFresh, every person who walks through our doors on day one deserves a strong and well structured start. As Training Supervisor, you will be the first face new starters see, the person who makes sure everyone is safe, skilled, and confident during their HelloFresh journey.

The Training Supervisor role is fast-paced, visible, and varied. No two weeks look the same when you're supporting a high-growth food production site. 

You'll lead and performance manage our Training Ambassadors, acting as their coach and point of escalation. Reporting into the Learning Business Partner, you'll play a key role in shaping how training is delivered across the site.

What You Will Be Doing:

• Host the training team shift handover brief at the start and end of each shift.

• Own the new starter experience end-to-end: delivering classroom inductions, site tours, and hands-on safety training so every joiner feels welcomed and work-ready from day one.

• Deliver ongoing Health & Safety and Food Safety refresher training in line with business policy and current legislation.

• Oversee the physical sign off process for safe systems of work and standard operating procedures, maintaining accurate training records in the training matrix.

• Run classroom and on-the-job sessions for a range of skills across Production and Warehouse.

• Use training data and compliance reporting to plan shift cover, identify gaps, and provide KPI updates to Training Management.

• Lead, coach, and performance manage the Training Ambassador team, including regular 1:1s, development conversations, and holding high standards.

• A single point of reference for the operational management team for essential business needs.
Champion Health & Safety in everything you do: lead by example, challenge unsafe behaviours, and motivate others to do the same.

• Ensure tech is fully accounted for and in excellent condition.

• Support training improvement projects and contribute to the continuous development of how we train at HelloFresh.

Who You Are:

• You have at least 1 year of experience in a training role, ideally within an operational, warehouse, or food production environment.

• You're a natural communicator, delivering a safety induction to 40+ new starters or having a one-to-one performance conversation with a Training Ambassador.

• You take Health & Safety seriously. You don't walk past it. You call it out, correct it, and help others understand why it matters.

• You're organised and data-driven. You can read a training matrix, spot a compliance gap, and take action without being asked.

• You have experience managing or supervising others, and you know how to get the best out of a team.

• You're adaptable and embrace change. When processes change or priorities shift, you recalibrate quickly and bring your team with you.

• English fluency is essential; additional languages are a real asset given the diversity of our site teams.

title: Community Health Solutions Lead - Remote
description:
Description:
The Associate Director, Community Health Solutions will play a pivotal role in expanding Amneal's presence and impact within the state, local, and community public-health marketplace. Working closely with the State Government Business Director, this individual will develop and manage strategic relationships with public-health agencies, community-based organizations, health systems, public-safety organizations, advocacy groups, coalitions, and other stakeholders responsible for addressing priority public-health needs.
The role will support Amneal's broader public-health portfolio, developing sustainable programs, partnerships, and business opportunities that increase access to medicines and strengthen Amneal's position as a trusted partner to government and community stakeholders. The position will be responsible for identifying opportunities across Amneal's public-health portfolio based on evolving state and community needs.The Associate Director will translate public-health needs into actionable commercial opportunities by understanding how healthcare policy, public funding, grants, state and local purchasing programs, community distribution models, and stakeholder advocacy influence product access and utilization. The individual will identify gaps in access, develop innovative solutions with customers and partners, and work collaboratively with the State Government Business Director to convert opportunities into sustainable procurement, contracting, distribution, and utilization. This position will serve as a key external representative of Amneal with community-health and public-interest stakeholders and will work cross-functionally to ensure that customer insights are translated into effective public-health, access, commercial, and policy strategies.
Essential Functions:

• Community Health Strategy, Business Development & Account Management: Identify, develop, and manage strategic relationships with public-health organizations, state and local agencies, community-based organizations, coalitions, Harm Reduction organizations, public-safety organizations, advocacy organizations, and other key stakeholders whose activities influence access to Amneal’s public-health portfolio. Serve as a primary point of contact for community and public-health stakeholders within assigned markets and coordinate appropriate Amneal resources to address customer needs. Identify opportunities to establish new accounts, expand existing accounts, and develop new community access points for products within Amneal’s public-health portfolio.

• Public Health Access, Partnerships & Program Development: Develop innovative partnerships and programs that improve availability, awareness, access, and appropriate utilization of Amneal portfolio within communities. Work with external stakeholders to understand barriers to access and develop innovative solutions to amplify growth and unique partnerships. Identify opportunities associated with federal and state grants, state appropriations, opioid-settlement funding, emergency-response funding, and other public-health funding sources. Develop relationships with key opinion leaders, public-health leaders, community influencers, advocacy organizations, and other stakeholders capable of advancing public-health programs and improving access to Amneal’s public health portfolio. Position Amneal as a collaborative partner committed to addressing important healthcare needs.

• Government Business & Procurement Partnership: Ensure close collaboration with other members of the Government Team, Government Affairs, Marketing, Generics, and Customer Operations, to capture relevant regional state/local government insights, identify gaps and develop strategic initiatives to pull-through contracts or awards at the regional level to ensure that programs achieve intended access, utilization and commercial objectives. Partner with the State Government Business Director on opportunities requiring government contracting
